prompts.run_male: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET of the attached TILMO male hero. Reference image is character identity reference: preserve face, silver hair , blue goggles, red scarf, navy/white/gold armor, boots. Both hands EMPTY in every frame, NO weapons. Exactly 6 columns and 8 rows, 48 complete separated small full-body characters, ONE character centered in each equal-size rectangular cell. NO drawn grid, no labels. Large portrait canvas 1536 by 2048, each implied cell 256 by 256. Consistent character height 190px within each cell, feet baseline at 225px, all hair/scarf fully inside cell. True transparent background. Camera fixed slightly overhead orthographic 2.5D cartoon RPG. Every row is ONE direction and six columns are sequential frames of a genuine RUN loop: left-foot contact, down/recoil, passing, right-foot contact, down/recoil, passing, with arms swinging opposite legs and scarf following. Row order TOP TO BOTTOM: 1 NORTH (back toward camera, running away); 2 NORTHEAST (back-right diagonal); 3 EAST (right profile); 4 SOUTHEAST (front-right diagonal); 5 SOUTH (front facing toward camera); 6 SOUTHWEST (front-left diagonal); 7 WEST (left profile); 8 NORTHWEST (back-left diagonal). Direction must stay constant within each row. The feet alternate positions across columns, NOT identical repeated poses. Keep head/body identity and scale consistent. Crisp polished anime cartoon sprites. No platforms, no shadows outside feet, no scenery, no effects, no text, no missing cells, no overlap between cells. Sheet only.
